name: Job Hunting
overview: Scripture reveals that God is intimately involved in the success and fruitfulness of our work, promising to bless and establish the labor of our hands for good as seen in Deuteronomy 30:9 and Psalms 90:17. The righteous are surrounded by God's favor and protection, which encourages trust in His provision during times of seeking employment (Psalms 5:12). Believers are reminded to act justly and generously when opportunities arise (Proverbs 3:27), while humbly recognizing that God's wisdom and mercy exceed human understanding, calling us to depend on His grace rather than our own merit (Job 11:6; Psalms 115:1).
